title: 第8章 神队友可以拯救一切

content_zh:
“那我们现在该怎么办？”
燕南天此时望向苏景的眼神，已经不是看向一个小小奴仆的眼神，而是看向一个真真正正可以与自己平辈论交，并且智谋更胜自己的高人的眼神！
武功低微，尚且能在邀月手中活下来，更兼之其隐藏身份惊人，铁血大旗门虽然已经没落多年，在江湖上完全消失了踪迹，但毕竟当年威名，燕南天也曾听说……单单这个身份，便足以得到他的尊重，更何况这还是个有情有义的好少年呢？
燕南天看人，素来只看为人不看身份，他以往对江琴看不大上眼，如今却突然感觉，他竟然对他相当的入眼了，甚至于其内心已经决定，此番若真能有幸将二弟救出来，那么定然要跟他说一说，免了这个好少年的奴籍……让他重新归于常人！说不得结拜也是可以的！
“眼下，也只能火中取栗，搏上一把了！”
苏景叹道：“就像燕大侠你说的那样，救出公子并不算难，但现在公子尚有一个怀孕的妻子，根本经不起颠簸，想要把他们都救出来，然后还全身而退，只能说燕大侠如果这么想的话，未免就太过小瞧了邀月的实力了！”
“某家自然知晓这样根本就是不可能的……江枫，你别在跟某家耍什么心眼，某家知道你是想让某家完全听从你的命令，你放心，只要某家确定你的计策能将某家二弟一家都救出来，那么某家自然不会有任何质疑！”
“燕大侠这么想真是再好不过了。”
苏景脸上不自觉浮现几分讪讪之意……他的意图才刚刚表现出来，竟然直接便被燕南天给看了个分明。
看来，书中说他性格虽然看似粗豪，但其实粗中有细，说来果然不虚，幸亏自己没有恶意，不然的话，恐怕已经直接被他一掌爆头了吧？！
但现在，他越厉害，越是帮助我的最佳帮手！
苏景看了一眼那面目粗豪的大汉，心底一股莫名的安全感升上了心头……这可真是神一般的队友啊！
虽然自己猪了一点，但一个神队友，足可拯救一切！！！
……………………………………
眨眼间，时间已经过去了三日。
这三天里，苏景便仿佛消失在这个世界一般，完全没有了踪迹！
甚至于，连燕南天都没有出现……
“可恨的家伙，莫不是我上了当不成？”
整整五日的时间，邀月几乎可说是不曾闭上自己的双眼，一想到江枫将会亲眼看着自己最亲近的大哥亲手杀了自己的妻子，想到他的脸上露出那种绝望痛苦的神色，她便觉得心底一阵阵扭曲的剧痛，心疼江枫的同时，却又不知从哪里冒出来一股快意之感……
这种快意，让她闭上眼睛便是花月奴惨死时候的景象。

如果不看到这样的场景的话，恐怕她下半辈子都休想再睡的安稳。
“可如今，江枫早已经带着花月奴那贱人驾车逃跑，江琴却却不见踪影，若再等下去，恐怕来不及了！”
邀月死死的盯着前方那一辆疾驰的马车，脸上满是扭曲之意，她之前顺着江琴来时的路，找到了江枫居住之所，整整五日的时间，她一直看着他，看着他用自己从未曾见过的温柔神色，对自己的一个婢女呵护备至，柔情万分……
甚至于，那可恨的婢女，腹部早已经高高的隆起！
那本该是只有自己才有资格怀上的孩子……竟然要由一个贱婢生下吗？
整整五天的时间。
邀月便只是痴痴的看着，看着他照顾她，看着他的神色变的惊疑不定，看着他怀疑江琴是不是已经遇害，所以决定带着花月奴逃跑……
她也越发的坚定了自己心中的信念。
必须要让江枫经受这世上最痛苦的事情才行……
江琴，你若再不出现，让我看到我想看到的戏码，那么我只好亲自出手，当着江枫的面，把那贱婢肚中的孩儿给掏出来生生摔死了！
虽然粗俗了些，但却也可稍缓我胸中怒意！
一路漫步而行，却能轻而易举的跟上那疾驰的马车，在那车里，有她的牵挂，也有她的憎恶……
所以，当看到十二星相拦截上了那马车的时候。
邀月并没有阻拦，只是心道果然江琴这小子没有欺骗自己，十二星相果然都盯上了江枫的宝物了！
只可惜这却是连苏景都没想到的事情，其实十二星相，压根就是苏景的前身，江琴去通风报信告知的。

content_en:
"So what do we do now?"
The way Yan Nantian looked at Su Jing at this time was no longer looking at a little servant, but looking at a master who could truly talk to his peers and was more resourceful than him!
Although his martial arts skills are low, he can still survive in the hands of Yao Yue, and his hidden identity is astonishing. Although the Iron Blood Banner Sect has been in decline for many years and has completely disappeared from the world, after all, Yan Nantian has heard of its great reputation back then... This identity alone is enough to gain his respect, not to mention that he is a good and affectionate young man?
Yan Nantian always looks at people based on their personality rather than their status. He used to look down on Jiang Qin, but now he suddenly feels that he is quite attracted to him. He has even decided in his heart that if he is lucky enough to rescue his second brother this time, he must talk to him and save this good boy from being a slave... and let him return to ordinary people! It’s okay to say that you can’t be sworn friends!
"Now, we can only take advantage of the fire and take a chance!"
Su Jing sighed: "Just like what you said, Master Yan, it is not difficult to rescue the young master, but now that the young master has a pregnant wife, he cannot withstand the bumps at all. If he wants to rescue them all, and then escape unscathed, I can only say that if Master Yan thinks so, he is underestimating Yao Yue's strength!"
"The certain family naturally knows that this is simply impossible...Jiang Feng, don't play tricks on the certain family. The certain family knows that you want the certain family to obey your orders completely. Don't worry, as long as the certain family is sure that your strategy can save the second brother and the whole family, then the certain family will naturally not have any doubts!"
"It's really the best thing for Master Yan to think so."
A hint of sarcasm appeared on Su Jing's face unconsciously... His intention had just been revealed, and it was immediately obvious to Yan Nantian.
It seems that the book says that although his character may seem rough and arrogant, he is actually rough in some subtle ways, which is indeed true. Fortunately, he has no ill intentions. Otherwise, I would have been directly shot in the head by his palm, right? !
But now, the more powerful he is, the more he is the best helper for me!
Su Jing glanced at the big man with a rough face, and felt an inexplicable sense of security in his heart... This is really a god-like teammate!
Although I am a little bit stupid, a good teammate can save everything! ! !
………………………………
In the blink of an eye, three days have passed.
In the past three days, Su Jing seemed to have disappeared from this world, with no trace at all!
In fact, even Yan Nantian didn't show up...
"Hateful guy, could it be that I was deceived?"
For five days, Yaoyue almost never closed her eyes. When she thought that Jiang Feng would watch her closest brother kill his wife with her own eyes, and when he thought of the desperate and painful look on his face, she felt a twisting pain in her heart. While feeling sorry for Jiang Feng, she felt a sense of pleasure coming out of nowhere...
This kind of pleasure made her close her eyes and it was the scene when Huayue Nu died tragically.
If she didn't see such a scene, I'm afraid she would never be able to sleep peacefully again for the rest of her life.
"But now, Jiang Feng has already driven away with that bitch Hua Yuenu, but Jiang Qin is nowhere to be seen. If we wait any longer, I'm afraid it will be too late!"
Yao Yue stared at the speeding carriage in front of her, with a twisted look on her face. She had followed the path Jiang Qin took to find Jiang Feng's residence. For five days, she had been looking at him, watching him use a gentle look that she had never seen before, caring for one of her maids with great tenderness...
In fact, that hateful maid's belly was already bulging!
That child that only she was qualified to conceive...should be given birth to by a lowly maid?
allFive whole days.
Yao Yue just watched infatuatedly, watching him take care of her, watching his expression become confused and uncertain, watching him doubt whether Jiang Qin had been killed, so he decided to run away with Hua Yuenu...
She also became more and more firm in her beliefs.
Jiang Feng must be allowed to endure the most painful thing in the world...
Jiang Qin, if you don't show up again and let me see the drama I want to see, then I will have to take action myself and take out the child from that wretched maid's belly in front of Jiang Feng and beat him to death!
Although it is a bit vulgar, it can also alleviate the anger in my chest!
Strolling all the way, she could easily keep up with the speeding carriage. In the car, there was her concern and her hatred...
So, when I saw the twelve stars intercepting the carriage.
Yao Yue did not stop her, but she thought that Jiang Qin had not deceived her. The twelve zodiac signs had indeed set their sights on Jiang Feng's treasure!
It's a pity that this is something that even Su Jing didn't expect. In fact, the twelve horoscopes were actually reported by Su Jing's predecessor, Jiang Qin.
